name: ANZ Group Holdings Limited
summary: ANZ Group Holdings Limited engages in the provision of banking and financial products and services to retail and business customers in Australia and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Personal, Business & Agri, and Institutional. It offers banking and wealth management services to consumer and private banking customers; banking services to small and medium enterprises, and the agricultural business.
